scoring.description: Each dimension is scored from 0.0 to 1.0, then multiplied by its weight. The sum is compared against the threshold to produce a binary signal: 1 (relevant) or 0 (irrelevant).

dimensions.tags: Match query tokens against #hashtag annotations in the note
dimensions.title: Match query tokens against the note's H1 heading and filename
dimensions.content: Log-normalized frequency of query tokens in the note body
dimensions.inbound_links: Popularity: how many other notes link to this note via [[WikiLinks]]
